candidates.title: Noida Sector 125 fire: Blaze at hotel spreads to nearby eateries, firefighting ops underway | Video
candidates.excerpt: A fire at Krishna Food Point in Sector 125 on Saturday spread to nearby eateries, causing panic. Firefighters deployed four vehicles and brought the blaze under control with police assistance. No casualties were reported.

candidates.title: Keralam School Students on Ooty Trip Get Stranded in Mudslide, Rescued
candidates.excerpt: The bus, carrying the students from the Palakkad region of Kerala on a tourist trip, got stranded on a hillside amid mud and debris following the landslide
